开关立即生效，默认关闭；启用后随应用启动，退出应用即停止。: Changes take effect immediately. Off by default; starts with the app when enabled and stops on exit.
仅监听本机并使用令牌鉴权。使用时保持应用运行；配置含访问令牌，只交给可信的 Ag: Listens on loopback with token authentication. Keep the app running; share the configuration only with trusted agents.
项目、请求、目录和环境的增删改查，移动排序、HTTP / GraphQL / S: Manage projects, requests, folders and environments; move and reorder documents, execute HTTP / GraphQL / SSE and WebSocket, cancel jobs, run collections, convert cURL and Bru, and export code.
使用已保存的 YAML 和原生请求引擎；存在未保存草稿或运行中请求时拒绝修改工作: Uses saved YAML and the native request engine. Workspace writes are blocked while drafts or requests are pending. Disabling the server cancels MCP jobs.
合并配置时保留其他服务。连接后让 Agent 调用 get_workspace；: Keep existing servers when merging configuration. Ask the agent to call get_workspace. Cloud agents cannot access this loopback address. If the port is busy, stop the other service or edit ~/.apifuck-native/mcp.json after exiting.
在终端执行命令，然后在 Claude Code 中运行 /mcp 检查连接。: Run this command in a terminal, then use /mcp in Claude Code to check the connection.
合并到 ~/.codex/config.toml，然后重新打开 Codex 会话: Merge into ~/.codex/config.toml, then reopen your Codex session.
合并到项目 opencode.json，然后运行 opencode mcp li: Merge into the project opencode.json, then run opencode mcp list.
使用内置 MCP 的 Pi，合并到 ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json；运: Use a Pi version with built-in MCP. Merge into ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json and run pi mcp list. In an existing session, run /reload followed by /mcp.
